[Thinking]
**Clarifying Apple Watch launch details**

I need to provide the Swedish version of the announcement date for the Apple Watch Series 2. It was announced on September 7, 2016, and I think the initial release was on September 16. Hmm, I might have confused the dates, though; maybe it shipped in some markets on September 13. I’ll clarify that it was actually shipping on September 16. Alright, let's get this right!
[/Thinking]

Apple Watch Series 2 (ofta kallad “Apple Watch 2”) presenterades den **7 september 2016** och började säljas i de första länderna den **16 september 2016**.
